items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: I've worked with Zooty at the Central Plaza.

ctx.x: Did you meet Barney Bigard? No. I thought in connection with your clarinet. I ran into him. Zooty.
Zooty. Yes. I've worked with Zooty at the Central Plaza. I remember that now.
Was Peretti in New York at that time?
